summary: Darko Mesaros gives a quick tour of the new, simpler way to get started on AWS. Sign up with Google, GitHub, or Apple, and you land in a ready-to-go project. Most new customers don't need a credit card, and you get $100 in free credits. Paste one prompt into your coding agent and it's hooked up to your AWS environment, so you can start building right away. Start building with the new AWS experience here: https://go.aws/4z8hbDC Read the blog: https://go.aws/3Vyv0N5 Follow AWS Developers! title: Getting Started on AWS Just Got Easier
